audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. False uniform truncation estimate and an invalid feasibility step; Rate theorems do not prescribe the shrinking truncation tolerance required by their proofs; Inconsistent scale indices in the stated tensor wavelet construction
limitations: M25-0244-F1 — False uniform truncation estimate and an invalid feasibility step — Counterevidence: G1=G2 branch has ||G^-1||||G||>=1; Theorem3.5 uses that branch and is not refuted. General infeasibility example does not prove failure of an inequality conditional on an existing minimizer or of the particular Radon instance.

M25-0244-F2 — Rate theorems do not prescribe the shrinking truncation tolerance required by their proofs — Counterevidence: Proofp41 clearly intends r of order2^-aJ. Earlier3.14/4.4 bounds retaining+r not refuted; choosing intendedshrinkingr removes counterexamples. Exactrecoveryr=beta0 survives.

M25-0244-F3 — Inconsistent scale indices in the stated tensor wavelet construction — Counterevidence: The main abstract hypotheses explicitly requireorthonormality and a standardregular compactONB exists; no recoveryfailure undercorrectONB is asserted.

M25-0244-F4 — The fixed-angle Radon norm is not bounded by support area alone — Counterevidence: If|K|wasmeant asundefineddiameter shorthand, notationmustbespecified. FixedcompactKboundednessneededintheapplicationholds.
M25-0244-F5 — Signed rather than absolute polar Jacobian in fan-beam coherence proof — Counterevidence: The advertisedcoherencebounditself followswithabsoluteJacobian.

M25-0244-F6 — Missing squared norm in a gRIP parameter display — Counterevidence: Finaltau inTheorem3.5p17 includes||G||² correctly, so intendedchoice fitsactualsample bound. This doesnotdisproveTheorem3.5.

Not performed: FullAppendixAconcentration/entropy reproof, all externalwavelet/Sobolevtheorems, publisherPDFcomparison, authorcode. Unchangedreportbuildandpageviews reusedonlythroughverifiedhash/dependencyhistory.
